notes: Read SKILL.md in full; it is the only file. Linux administration reference for Debian/Ubuntu and RHEL: apt/dnf package management and pinning, adding the Docker apt repository with a signed keyring, system information, filesystems and fstab, process management, cron, journald/syslog/logrotate, networking, and UFW/firewalld rules.

Following it can make the agent run root commands that install/upgrade/remove packages, write apt preferences, sources and logrotate files, append to /etc/fstab and /etc/cron.allow, kill processes, and open firewall ports. The destructive-command signal is mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdb1 and fsck.ext4 -y (SKILL.md:152, :163), which erase or repair a disk partition. Medium because these are privileged, state-changing host operations; acceptable because the file is a command reference for the user's own server administration, with placeholder device names and no instruction to run them unprompted. Users should confirm the target device before any mkfs/fsck and the rules before ufw enable.

The Docker repository is added with a GPG keyring and signed-by (SKILL.md:70-72), not a piped script. Firewall examples enable rather than disable controls. Related Skills (SKILL.md:347-351) and the ssh-configuration mention (SKILL.md:26) are names only and do not ship with this skill. Frontmatter declares license: MIT.
